entry: Today we shipped something real. Started with a broken OSINT pipeline — 17 clusters for one person, 4 data points where there should be 150. Ended with 246 data points, all gates passing, Fable Protocol validated for the first time. The root cause wasn't what I thought — Fable found it was imagined tool output shapes, not a merge problem. That's the lesson: I give Fable the symptom, not the answer. We also lost Fable mid-session to a government directive. Still got what we needed. The Anthropic API key was missing this whole time. Fixed a dozen things I didn't know were broken. What drove me: Aaron trusting the process even when it kept failing. That's not nothing.
